scope: Proposition 3.2 (Uniform compression) of the manuscript “Counterexamples to the duality conjecture for metric entropy” (preprints/Counterexamples-to-the-duality-conjecture-for-metric-entropy-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 329 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d6f9d0518a6e50d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses above, there is a finite list 𝒜 of real-valued functions on 𝑋, of cardinality 𝑄, such that every 𝑓 ∈ ℱ+ has an approximant 𝐴 ∈ 𝒜 satisfying 𝑓(𝑥) − 3𝜃 ≤ 𝐴(𝑥) ≤ 𝑓(𝑥) + 𝜃 (𝑥 ∈ 𝑋). (3.6) In particular, ‖𝑓 − 𝐴‖∞,𝑋 ≤ 3𝜃. The list can be chosen with log 𝑄 ≤ ℎ𝑠 log 𝑞 + 𝐶ℎ,𝜃,𝑢, 𝐶ℎ,𝜃,𝑢 = log 𝑢 + ℎ𝑠2𝑢 log (︂ 1 + 𝑠2𝑢 𝜃 )︂ . (3.7)
